title: [finding] ObjectGallery draws a hard-coded English "No items to display" that ignores the view's emptyState and the locale
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`), from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2776 dev report (cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2793). ⛔ Not graded: grading is triage's. ⛔ Not a claim. ## The claim An empty gallery says "No items to display" in English in every locale, and draws it in place of any empty state the view authored. The public door: the cloud console, 「高级 → 我的软件包」 for a free account. The 2026-10-12 staging walkthrough screenshot `11-my-packages-empty.jpg` on objectstack-ai/cloud#2776 shows the English line in the zh-CN console. ## Evidence - `packages/plugin-list/src/ObjectGallery.tsx:653` on objectui `main` `54159d3`: `if (!items.length) return
No items to display
;`. The string is not translated, and the view's `emptyState` is not read. - `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:5518` (at cloud's objectui pin `d758f2f2`): the authored or translated empty state is drawn only when the current view is a grid. ## What is wanted The gallery draws the same empty state as the grid: the authored `emptyState` when there is one, translated, otherwise the console's localized generic copy. - A page-level list's own empty state (`InterfacePageConfigSchema`) is a separate spec gap, filed in objectstack beside this one. - The cloud-side English-string sweep objectstack-ai/cloud#2435 named this line, but the fix is objectui's. Dedupe: searched objectui issues for "No items to display", gallery empty state and `ObjectGallery` empty. The only match is objectstack-ai/objectui#11687 (closed; list empty-state wording beside Invite / Register buttons, a different surface). --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
